description.en: Unlocks a skill with the standard "J_08" jingle presentation and a caller-specified message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunUnlockSkillEx.
Character ID whose skill is unlocked.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Unlock a skill with a specific message, as RunUnlockSkill does internally
RunUnlockSkillUseMsg(_chr, _skill, "sysmes-Skill-00001");
